title: items[].output of use case 05
description: A library image (its dimensions per model, nearest neighbours by dinov3, near-duplicate group) or a text query (its ranking by siglip2). Vectors are not part of the output: they are in the index.

dimensions.description: Vector length per model, as returned by the API.

neighbors.description: Ids of the most similar other images by dinov3, best first.

neighborScores.description: Cosine similarity of each neighbour, same order.

duplicateGroup.description: Id of the first image of its near-duplicate group at the default threshold; null when it has no near-duplicate.

ranking.description: Ids of the best matching images by siglip2, best first.
